_protocol_version_note: Fresh holdout rounds use protocol v2: every produced document is judged by both roles, artifact conformance is a separate gate, and judge responses are schema-validated under the fresh atomic seal. Omit only when reproducing a historical v1 batch.
_nonstandard_config_note: Production/holdout configs keep this false: every run then requires the registered three-arm topology. Dev/tuning configs with fewer arms must set it true.
_judge_live_probe_note: Before sealing holdout-v2-round10, run judge_live_probe.py --config FILLED_CONFIG. It derives the only permitted sibling judge-live-probe namespace from seal_manifest. Replace both zero sentinels with its receipt/execution digests, register them once in pilot_registration.py, and bind the same values into seal metadata; standard runner/operator phases reject pending or drifted proof.
_subagent_model_live_probe_note: Before sealing holdout-v2-round10, run subagent_model_live_probe.py --config FILLED_CONFIG in its canonical clean sibling namespace. The public fixture deliberately requests child model: sonnet; acceptance requires the harness-owned Opus override on both parent and child. Replace both zero sentinels with its receipt/execution digests and register the same values in pilot_registration.py; standard phases require this proof in addition to the judge transport probe.
_operator_runtime_note: Standard protocol-v2 execution requires this exact operator image and PyYAML parser. The operator host/container must export RPA_OPERATOR_IMAGE_SHA256 with the same digest; gates verify both the imported yaml module and installed PyYAML distribution are exactly 6.0.2 before any backend observation.
_comment: Eval-runner configuration example (pilot plan, prerequisite 5). Copy, fill in real installation dirs + hashes at candidate freeze, and keep the filled copy in the private eval workspace. All arms must share model/effort per the pinned runtime configuration (enforced by validate_arm_parity); only installation content differs. NOTE: with the real claude CLI the arm's `model` must equal the effective model id the CLI reports in stream events (e.g. a full claude-... id, not an alias) — establish the exact value during the real-backend preflight.

ablation._schedule_tasks_note: The third arm runs on exactly its two pre-registered designated tasks; --make-schedule refuses a no-subagent arm without this explicit two-task scope.
ablation._forbid_subagents_note: Pre-registered third-arm policy: a fleet-ablation run that spawns any subagent is a counted workflow failure.

_entrypoint_note: Plugin commands are namespaced: the real CLI resolves /rpa:research_codebase, while a bare /research_codebase yields a client-side Unknown-command notice (synthetic event) and no workflow — established in the 2026-07-27 real-backend shakedown. The command file's own `model:` pin overrides the CLI --model for the invoked turn, so each arm's registered `model` must equal the full id that PIN resolves to (e.g. claude-opus-5), confirmed from stream events at the real-backend preflight.
_backend_cmd_note: {installation} expands per run to the verified installation copy mounted inside the run's clean profile; {effort} expands to the arm's registered effort so it is pinned on the command line, not inherited. Adjust flags to whatever the pinned Claude Code version uses for local plugin loading and effort control — validated during the real-backend preflight. The arm's `entrypoint` is prefixed to the task prompt so the session actually enters the evaluated workflow.
_judge_backend_cmd_note: Judge sessions must be mount-free: no {installation} placeholder, no plugin flags. The runner refuses to score if the resolved judge command still contains {installation}. {effort} expands to judge_effort. Do not add --json-schema: protocol v2 supplies its exact generic public structural schema itself and refuses caller overrides.
_workflow_abort_exit_codes_note: Backend exit codes that mean the evaluated workflow itself gave up (counted as workflow_failure, never rerun). Any other nonzero exit is infra_failure (rerun). Real values for the pinned claude CLI are established during the real-backend preflight; leave empty until then.
_max_infra_retries_note: Infrastructure failures invalidate the run and are re-executed automatically up to this many additional attempts; every attempt's record is written. Workflow failures are counted, never replaced.
_max_judge_attempts_note: Protocol v2 fixes three total fresh judge attempts per required record. Only schema/transport-invalid attempts are retried; the first valid response binds, all attempts are retained, and exhaustion invalidates the round.
_environment_policy_note: Protocol v2 uses the fixed claude-cli-minimal-env-v3-subagent-model-pin-pyyaml-6.0.2 policy in runner.py. Arbitrary ambient variables (including unrelated cloud and source-control credentials, the operator-image attestation, and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL) never reach evaluated or judge sessions; after allowlisting, the harness sets CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL from that session's registered arm/judge model.
_sandbox_cmd_note: REQUIRED exact registered invocation. Linux uses ns_sandbox.py; macOS uses macos_sandbox.py. The shared registration gate checks interpreter behavior, platform basename, immutable wrapper SHA-256, and the complete argument tail before any schedule/output mutation or model launch.
_drift_fetch_cmd_note: REQUIRED to score external-context tasks: the harness itself re-fetches every sealed live source URL (from the seal's snapshot_sources) through this registered command and diffs the bytes against the sealed digests. -q disables ambient .curlrc state; the safely quoted URL is sent as curl-config data on stdin and never appears in argv or error text. Each changed-file adjudication is exactly {observed_sha256, material, rationale}; observed_sha256 must equal the harness's own live fetch, so a verdict cannot be reused for different bytes. Operator-supplied local copies are never accepted as drift evidence.
_seal_manifest_note: Path to the protocol-v2 package manifest (complete file map; task→distinct context and role→prompt/schema associations; quality rubric; coverage matrix; exact ablation_tasks; HTTPS snapshot provenance; retry/output/aggregation policies; judge_config; registered judge_live_probe proof). Its own SHA-256 must equal seal_package_sha256, and the complete package is re-verified for missing, extra, changed, symlink, or special-file entries before scheduling, scoring, and aggregation.
_seal_package_registration_note: Keep the exact zero sentinel only through the public live probe and atomic seal build. Then register the returned package SHA-256 in pilot_registration.py and this private config before schedule creation; direct runner, sealer verification, and step-5 all consume that one shared value.
_backend_version_note: Probed before every run and judge pass; any drift from the registered version blocks the run (pinned-runtime protocol).
_timeout_seconds_note: Run-level deadline shared by the initial session and every driver continuation — resumed sessions receive only the remaining time, never a fresh full timeout.
